text: Hello there! Here is your weather report for Monday, November 9. Monday again. Let's start the week well! In Shanghai today, expect it to be damp with light drizzle. Temperatures will go up to 15 degrees, with a low of 8. Comfortable enough to forget about the weather altogether. Rain is about 62 percent likely today. There's a fair breeze about today too. The sun goes down at 4:59 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Pack your umbrella and your wellies! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be under a blanket of cloud, with a high of 15 degrees. This week our theme is warm drinks. Notice how they warm your hands first. That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
